messages.author: d59d695135aeef34
messages.subject: Can't deploy apps. 400 Validation Error
parts:
I tried to use this code to deploy an app:
shinyapps::deployApp(appDir = "apps2.0", appName = "Model Internal Validation Kit 2.1")

But I constantly getting error message when I tried to deploy the app: 

Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Validation Error

Please help me!

I have tried many different tokens and it does not work. I'm pretty sure my directory is right.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Can't deploy apps. 400 Validation Error
parts:
Simon,

Your application name is invalid. It can not have any spaces in it. Because it will be used as part of the application URL when it is deployed, it should only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. 

Sorry for the confusion. 
-Andy
